integrity: The proof derives the exact support and complement conditions from the swap definition. The verifier independently reconstructs adjacency, domination, and every admissible swap, then checks the closed polynomial coefficientwise.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs and ordinary co-secure domination.
The exhaustive verifier covers total order at most ten; the arbitrary-order result is analytic.
Originality is assessed against targeted database and literature searches and is not an absolute uniqueness guarantee.
title: All co-secure dominating sets of complete multipartite graphs
